Aussie  Burnouts Beta

A classic Aussie burnout and cruising game.

Jump in, grab a car, cruise the map, skid with friends and enjoy a simple Australian-inspired freeroam experience.

🚨⚠️ LOST YOUR PROGRESS DUE TO THE REVAMP? ⚠️🚨

Join our socials and contact support — we’ll help you get sorted. 🚨

🔥 Burnouts & drifting
🚗 Aussie cars
🌏 Open-world cruising
🔧 Almost daily events
💰 Earn cash while you play
👥 Cruise and skid with friends

This is an older game that remains available to play while newer projects continue development.

Any exploiting will result in a permanent ban.

⚠️ Some systems may be dated and occasional bugs may occur.
⭐ Like and favourite if you enjoy the game.
